natal.title: Natal Chart & Life Transits
natal.intro: Enter birth date, time and place to compute the natal chart with astronomical precision (Swiss Ephemeris), every transit to the chart across a lifetime — with exact dates for each pass — and the secondary progressions.
natal.badge.unknown_time: No time — noon chart, no houses
natal.privacy: Privacy: birth data travels only in this page's URL and is processed in memory. The server does not store it, log it or share it. You may save the link in your browser.
natal.field.label: Name or nickname
natal.field.time_help: Without a time the chart is computed at local noon: no houses or angles; the Moon gets an uncertainty range.
natal.field.place_ph: Type the city (e.g. São Paulo, Lisbon, Tokyo)…
natal.field.gazetteer_missing: City database unavailable on this server — enter latitude, longitude and time zone manually.
natal.field.tz_help: filled from the city; before standard time, local mean time is used
natal.field.orb_help: Short orbs for slow planets, wider for fast ones; +0.5° on Sun, Moon, ASC and MC.
natal.field.minors: Include minor aspects (30°, 45°, 135°, 150°) at half orb
natal.field.moon_transits: Include transiting Moon in the focus year (conjunction/opposition only, 3° orb)
natal.examples_help: Public births with Astrodatabank-rated times; click to load.
natal.how.title: How it works
natal.how.1: The chart uses the tropical zodiac, Placidus houses (or the chosen system), planets through Pluto, Chiron, North Node and mean Lilith — the basis of modern astrology.
natal.how.2: Transits are scanned day by day from birth to age 100; every exact pass (including retrograde ones) is refined to the minute.
natal.how.3: Secondary progressions use the convention 1 day = 1 tropical year, with the progressed Moon as the guiding thread.
natal.how.orbs: The transiting Moon is ignored by default (its transits last hours); the natal and progressed Moon are included normally.
natal.chart.noon_note: Chart computed at local noon, without houses or angles.
natal.chart.moon_range: The Moon may be anywhere within a {amp}° range on this day.
natal.chart.read.1: The outer ring shows the 12 signs; each inner glyph is a body at its tropical ecliptic longitude.
natal.chart.read.2: Lines in the centre are natal aspects: amber = conjunction, rose = square/opposition (tension), blue = trine/sextile (flow).
natal.chart.read.3: With a known time, the Ascendant sits on the left and the Placidus houses divide the wheel into 12 life sectors.
natal.chart.read.4: ℞ marks apparent retrograde motion at birth.
natal.chart.no_houses: Houses unavailable without a birth time.
natal.transits.progressed_note: You are viewing transits to the PROGRESSED CHART (moving targets by secondary progression). Back to:
natal.transits.try_progressed: View transits to the progressed chart
natal.now.title: Now
natal.now.help: Windows active on the reference date and upcoming exact passes within 12 months.
natal.timeline.title: Life timeline
natal.timeline.help: Each lane is a transiting planet (slow ones first). Bars are episodes within orb; opacity follows the closest approach; dots mark exact passes. Hover for details and click to open the year.
natal.timeline.aria: Timeline of planetary transits to the natal chart across the lifetime
natal.heatmap.title: Life heatmap
natal.heatmap.help: Annual intensity per life domain on a 0–1000 scale calibrated against a synthetic population of births (percentile). Click a year to open it.
natal.keyyears.title: Key years
natal.keyyears.help: Local maxima of total intensity (percentile ≥ 80), with the transits that contribute most.
natal.cycles.title: Life cycles
natal.cycles.help: Returns and aspects of each planet to its own natal position — modern astrology's generic age markers, here with your exact dates.
natal.year.title: Focus year
natal.year.help: Slow transits active in the year (with interpretation) and, below, the year's fast triggers (Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars).
natal.year.slow: Slow transits active in the year
natal.year.none: No slow transit within orb this year.
natal.year.fast_help: orbs up to 4°; Moon ignored by default
natal.moon_skipped: Transiting Moon omitted: available only for ranges up to 2 years.
natal.houses.title: Transits through houses
natal.houses.help: Periods in which each slow planet travels through the natal houses (including retrograde re-entries).
natal.prog.method: Secondary progressions: 1 day = {year} days of life; progressed MC by {mc}.
natal.prog.biwheel_help: Bi-wheel: natal on the inner ring, progressed on the outer; lines = progressed→natal aspects.
natal.prog.aspects_now: Progressed → natal aspects on the date
natal.prog.moon_help: The progressed Moon changes sign every ~2.5 years and completes a round in ~27 years: it is the emotional clock of progressions.
natal.prog.moon_aspects: Exact aspects of the progressed Moon to the natal chart
natal.prog.ingresses_help: Sign changes of progressed Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars, ASC and MC; stations (direct ↔ retrograde) of the progressed personal planets.
